modelOverview: The Nautilus 7118 is Patek Philippe's ladies' automatic Nautilus, introduced at Baselworld 2019 as the successor to the 7018/1A. Its 35.2mm case keeps the collection's rounded-octagonal bezel, porthole construction and integrated bracelet, with a wave-pattern dial in place of the men's horizontal embossing and the self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C with date and sweep seconds visible through a sapphire caseback. It is offered with or without a diamond-set bezel in stainless steel and 18k rose gold.

7118/1A-001.materials: Stainless steel case and integrated bracelet with patented fold-over clasp and lockable adjustment system
7118/1A-001.bezel: Steel rounded-octagonal Nautilus bezel with contrasting polished and satin-brushed finishes, no diamonds
7118/1A-001.dial: Blue opaline dial with wave pattern, white gold applied numerals and hour markers with white luminescent coating, white gold alpha-style hands, date aperture at 6 o'clock
7118/1A-001.description: The 7118/1A-001 is the non-gem-set steel ladies' Nautilus with a blue opaline wave-pattern dial, the closest counterpart in the women's line to the men's blue-dial steel Nautilus. Its 35.2mm case houses the 215-part Calibre 26-330 S C with date, sweep seconds and 21k gold central rotor. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.
